`VPro 2.0` (*VENUS — Vegetation and Environment NexUS — Professional*) replaces legacy Microsoft Access `VPro64` forms and VBA modules with two interoperable engines backed by the exact same 7-database `VP08` SQLite WAL physical schema and PostgreSQL `BECMaster` cloud schemas:

1. **Desktop Workstation (`app/`):** Go 1.27+ backend (`app/internal/*`) + Wails v3 / Svelte 5 / MapLibre GL JS v6 desktop interface (`app/frontend/src/*`).
2. **Headless R Companion SDK (`r/`):** Zero-UI `vpro` 2.0 package (`89` curated exports) standardized around `ws` (`vpro_workspace` local SQLite / `.rds`) and `pg` (`vpro_pg_conn` PostgreSQL `BECMaster`) handles.

## Shared `VP08` & Cloud `BECMaster` Invariants

All three generations (or both modern engines where Access had no native equivalent) share these domain rules without divergence:

- **7-Database `VP08` WAL Layout:** `<Project>.db` (`_Env`, `_Admin`, `_Veg`, `_Humus`, `_Mineral`, `_Other`, `_Audit`, `_Metadata`, plus `*_SU`, `*_Hierarchy` with `~` breakpoints, `*_Lump`, `*_Profile`, `__VPRO_*`), `VPro64.db`, `VLists.db` (`BCPlantTaxonomy v19`, `BECdb v13`, `LMH25 2023`), `VUser.db`, `VMetaData.db`, `VMessageBoard.db`, and `VPics.db`.
- **Literal Text `PlotNumber` (`Text 7`):** Always stored and joined as character preserving leading zeroes (e.g., `"00337"`).
- **Access Booleans, IEEE-754 `float32` Cover Narrowing & `99%` Lump Cap:** `-1` (`TRUE`), `0` (`FALSE`), `NA`/`NULL`; species covers narrow through 32-bit float before `< 100` bounds; lumped (`*_Lump`) and `TotalA`/`TotalB` sums cap at `99%`; ACE rounding formats doubles to 15 significant digits before half-away rounding (`vpro_round_ace()`).
- **`LMH25 (2023)` Soil Horizon Depth Sign & Ordering:** Upland organic `L`/`F`/`H` horizons measure upward from `0 cm` (`UpperDepth > LowerDepth`, ordered `DESC`); wetland `Of`/`Om`/`Oh` and mineral horizons measure downward (`UpperDepth < LowerDepth`, ordered `ASC`).
- **Explicit Cover Precedence:** Plot summaries and community matrices default to `cover_precedence = "strata_totals"` (`StrataCover*` when non-zero; fallback capped `99%`), whereas `vpro_diagnostics()`, `vpro_pairwise()`, and `vpro_outliers()` default to `"sublayer_sum"` to preserve MS Access `V7mdlDiagnostic` parity.

## R 1.0 -> R 2.0 Clean-Slate Migration Reference (`99 -> 89` Exports)

`vpro` 2.0 removes legacy shims (`0` deprecated wrappers) and consolidates overlapping helpers:

| Category | Legacy R 1.x Call | R 2.0 Clean-Slate Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| **Renamed (8)** | `vpro_standards_sync(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_standards_sync(pg, ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_publish_snapshot(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_publish_snapshot(pg, ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_list_snapshots(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_list_snapshots(pg, ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_write_rds_snapshot(ws, dest_path = ...)` | `vpro_export_rds(ws, path = ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_read_rds_project(path, su_table = ..., lump_table = ...)` | `vpro_import_rds(path, su = ..., lump = ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `plot_edatope(...)` | `vpro_plot_edatope(...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_rule(table = ...)` | `vpro_profile_rule(table = ...)` *(supports `table = "Lump"`)* |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_diagnostic_classify(...)` | `vpro_classify_diagnostic_codes(...)` |
| **Merged (7)** | `vpro_master_verify_audit(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_audit(pg, ..., verify_chain = TRUE)` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_check_lmh25(ws)` | `vpro_validate(ws, scope, checks = "lmh25")$lmh25` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_presence_class_numeric(p)` | `vpro_presence_class(p, format = "numeric")` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_sample()` | `vpro_connect("Sample")` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_project_discover(...)` | `vpro_list_projects(...)` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_project_validate(...)` | `vpro_project_inspect(...)` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_write_candidate_su(ws, cl)` | `vpro_write_su(ws, cl, candidate = TRUE)` |
| **Internal (2)** | `vpro_coord_elev_hash()`, `vpro_sidecar_exec()` | Internal `vpro:::.vpro_coord_elev_hash()`, `vpro:::.vpro_sidecar_exec()` |
| **Removed (1)** | `vpro_round_minimum()` | `vpro_round_ace()` |

## Quick Runnable Parity Check (`Sample.db`)

```{r}
library(vpro)

ws <- vpro_connect("Sample")
vpro_status(ws)

# Cover precedence parity: strata_totals vs sublayer_sum on Sample plot 108050
veg_strata <- vpro_veg(ws, strata = "total", combine = "sum", cover_precedence = "strata_totals")
veg_subsum <- vpro_veg(ws, strata = "total", combine = "sum", cover_precedence = "sublayer_sum")

c(
  strata_totals = veg_strata$Cover[veg_strata$PlotNumber == "108050" & veg_strata$Species == "ABIE_RK"],
  sublayer_sum = veg_subsum$Cover[veg_subsum$PlotNumber == "108050" & veg_subsum$Species == "ABIE_RK"]
)

# Profile rules differentiate Table = "Lump" vs raw Table = "Veg"
prof_default <- vpro_profile(ws, lump = TRUE)
length(prof_default$plots)

rules_raw_vs_lump <- list(
  vpro_profile_rule(table = "Lump", species = "EPILSPP", layer = "Any", operator = ">", value = 0, operation = "Add")
)
prof_lump <- vpro_profile(ws, rules = rules_raw_vs_lump, lump = TRUE)
length(prof_lump$plots)
```
